label: sec:color-tube-coords-intro
html:
The braid-group action on the resolvents isolates three S_5-invariants. We now adopt those invariants as the coordinate system. We introduce the variables c_r, c_g, c_b and their aggregates. We identify named combinations (\hat c, total charge) required for the subsequent analysis. We then reformulate the Bring quadric and cubic as identities among these aggregates.

The three tubes correspond to the three color charges. Pure-color loci correspond to confinement. We specify the residual C_5 symmetry that survives the S_5 quotient. We then extract the intrinsic color cubic pairing. This pairing furnishes the defining datum of the elliptic structure \mathcal{E}_q constructed in the next section.
